name: scene3d_patch_object_clip
description: Play a baked model clip or a namespaced mocap clip (`mocap:<id>`) during a Motion take: choose the clip, speed, loop, and start time. scene3d_search_library_objects lists mocap ids; scene3d_state lists GLB clips. Travel across the scene is scene3d_add_object_keyframes instead. For two-person pairs, both halves stay frame-locked only with startTime: 0, the same speed, and both objects at the same transform; root motion in each half reconstructs the staging. @see guides_get('scene3d')

enabled.description: false freezes the model for this take.

loop.description: false holds the last frame instead of repeating. Default true.

name.description: Baked clip name from scene3d_state, or a complete mocap name from scene3d_search_library_objects (for example `mocap:walk`). Omit for the model's first clip.

objectId.description: Placed object whose model ships animations (scene3d_state → clips).

reset.description: true drops all clip settings (first clip, looping).

shotId.description: Take to animate in. Required once the sequence has more than one.

startTime.description: Take-local second the animation starts at; before it the model holds its first frame. Default 0.
